# porch_policy (Resource)

An ABAC policy of a tenant written in expr-lang over `principal`, `resource`, `action`, `context` and `now`. A `condition` policy is referenced by role assignments and must be true for them to apply (e.g. `context.hour >= 7 && context.hour < 21`); a `deny` policy overrides grants for its `actions`. Needs `policy:manage`; updates replace the policy (PUT). Import with `<tenant>/<policy_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Condition policy: referenced by assignments, which then apply only while it is true.
resource "porch_policy" "daytime" {
  tenant     = porch_tenant.smiths.id
  slug       = "daytime"
  name       = "Between 07:00 and 21:00 UTC"
  effect     = "condition"
  expression = "context.hour >= 7 && context.hour < 21"
}

# Deny policy: overrides every grant of its actions.
resource "porch_policy" "no_delete" {
  tenant     = porch_tenant.smiths.id
  slug       = "no-delete"
  name       = "Nobody deletes media"
  effect     = "deny"
  actions    = ["media:delete"]
  expression = "true"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `effect` (String) `condition` or `deny`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `expression` (String) Boolean expr-lang expression (compiled by Porch on save).
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Identifier, unique in the tenant. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `tenant` (String) ID or slug of the tenant that owns this object. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `actions` (Set of String) Deny policies only: permissions the policy applies to (`*` for all). Must be empty for conditions.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Policy ID (`pol_…`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import porch_policy.daytime <tenant>/<policy_id>
```
